scripts.check: bun tools/hooks/present.ts && vp check --deny-warnings && ./node_modules/.bin/supdoc check --deny-warnings && bun run ui:typecheck
scripts.db:regenerate: git clean -fdq apps/api/migrations && bun run db:generate
scripts.db:generate: cd apps/api && ../../node_modules/.bin/drizzle-kit generate && bun ./scripts/migrations-digest.ts && cd ../auth && ../../node_modules/.bin/drizzle-kit generate
scripts.prepare: git rev-parse --git-dir >/dev/null 2>&1 && git config --local core.hooksPath .vite-hooks || true && bun tools/supdoc/install.ts
